infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Optimal Slepp reads heart rate from Apple Watch for more precise sleep phase detection.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Optimal Slepp writes sleep analysis to Apple Health after completed night recording.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Optimal Slepp uses the accelerometer to detect movement during sleep.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Optimal Slepp uses the microphone to analyze breathing and snoring sounds during sleep.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Optimal Slepp sends notifications about sleep analysis and bedtime reminders.
